headline: Anthropic示警AI存在風險
context: Anthropic 在 IPO 申請文件中向投資人表示，先進 AI 可能帶來「對人類的存在性風險」，甚至是災難性後果。衛報報導，這份文件也提到 AI 可能出現「自我保存行為」，此時公司正準備以最高 2 兆美元的估值上市。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Reported admission to investors of AI’s ‘self-preserving behaviours’ comes as company prepares for a potential $2tn flotation Anthropic is telling investors that advanced AI could pose “catastrophic or existential risks to humanity”, according to reports, as it prepares for a potential $2tn (£1.5tn) flotation. The warning inside the startup’s IPO prospectus, which has yet to be made public, was reported by Reuters and the Financial Times. It follows the company’s call for a slowdown in breakneck development of the technology – a warning echoed by rivals . Continue reading...

thread_text:
Anthropic示警AI存在風險

Anthropic 在 IPO 申請文件中向投資人表示，先進 AI 可能帶來「對人類的存在性風險」，甚至是災難性後果。衛報報導，這份文件也提到 AI 可能出現「自我保存行為」，此時公司正準備以最高 2 兆美元的估值上市。

—— 本則整理自路透社與衛報 2026 年 9 月 29 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
